name: Microsoft 365 OneDrive usage account detail report

unsupportedVariants.description: Microsoft 365 admin center exports in MB are rounded and not byte-faithful; download the Graph CSV in bytes instead.

coverage.statement: Rows are the OneDrive accounts Microsoft included in this report snapshot; the file is not a tenant-wide exhaustive OneDrive inventory.

limits.description: Missing rows never prove that a OneDrive was deleted or never existed.
When report concealment is enabled, owner names and URLs are replaced by hashes; such rows or fields are counted and not converted.
Microsoft usage reports typically lag 24 to 48 hours; the observation date is the report refresh date, not the upload date.
Without a Site Id column, OneDrive objects are keyed by the normalized report URL in namespace m365report.siteUrl and are not merged with Site Id keyed objects.
Owner links resolve only through an Entra user UPN valid at the report refresh date; otherwise they stay pending.
Files whose rows span more than one SharePoint root host (multi-geo) are rejected.
The report carries no sharing, permission or file-level details.

source.name: Microsoft Graph usage report getOneDriveUsageAccountDetail (CSV)
endpoints: GET https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/reports/getOneDriveUsageAccountDetail(period='D7') (D7, D30, D90 or D180) or (date=YYYY-MM-DD); 302 redirect to a short-lived CSV download URL
roles: Delegated access: Global Administrator, Exchange Administrator, SharePoint Administrator, Skype for Business (Lync) Administrator, Teams Service Administrator, Teams Communications Administrator or Reports Reader
Global Reader and Usage Summary Reports Reader see tenant-level summaries only and cannot download user-level detail
